quest.title: Ritou Escape Plan
quest.description: Thoma has set you a test to leave Ritou by your own power, lest your journey end here...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x800, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia

dialogues.speaker: Kobayashi
dialogues.text: Stop there! Present your Travel Permits!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, but we've really gotta get to Narukami Island, it's kinda urgent...

dialogues.speaker: Kobayashi
dialogues.text: If you don't have a Travel Permit, this is as far as you'll get. Those are the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traveler, you gotta think of something. How do we get out of Ritou?

choices.text: If the Yashiro Commission has heard of us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you saying... we should go and meet with the Kanjou Commissioner?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Guess it can't hurt to try. Even if Paimon has a few choice words to say about his subordinates...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows — maybe he's our biggest fan! Hee-hee.

choices.text: I wonder if the Kanjou Commission has heard of us...

talks.objective: Go to the Kanjou Commissioner's Office to ask about a way to leave Ritou

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: Halt! This is the Kanjou Commissioner's Office. No trespassers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here to see, uh... y'know, um... the Kanjou Commissioner!

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commissioner seldom entertains outlanders. Leave, now or we'll be forced to—

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: Ah... Wait, wait, wait...

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: Oh! Commissioner!

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: These two are honored guests from afar, no need to give them the usual spiel.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: Come on in, let's see what we can do for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Did you get all that, mister!?

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: M—My sincere apologies.

talks.objective: Talk to Shinsuke of the Kanjou Commission

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: I am Hiiragi Shinsuke, Kanjou Commissioner and head of the Hiiragi Clan. It's an honor to meet you both.

choices.text: I, too, am honored to meet you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice to meet you, Sir!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, the reason we wanted to come and see you was because—

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Alright, alright, all in good time. Two travelers renowned far and wide have shown up to see me, and I should very much like to make their acquaintance! Let's not limit this to business only.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hee-hee, so what you're saying is, we really are pretty famous, huh?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Absolutely. How many other people in the world have what it takes to knock the wind out of Stormterror's sails and put the Overlord of the Vortex back under the sea, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon thinks you make an excellent point.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: And... I hear you also foiled a Fatui plot in Liyue Harbor, even beat one of their harbingers in a duel. Is that true?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! You heard about that, too? Yup, it's true, alright!

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Hmm... As I thought.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Something wrong?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Hehe, no, no, no. I'm simply awestruck by you both, is all.

choices.text: You're too kind.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: ...Ritou is greatly honored to have you visit us.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: One other thing I heard about you is your great zeal for helping other people. This makes me wonder... whether you might be so kind as to render your assistance to the Kanjou Commission?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Sure, no problem! Whatever you need — right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Time to run some errands again?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Excellent. Well, then...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: You must know the Qingxin? A flower, grows on the mountaintops in Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, we've picked a few of those before. So, uh... you want us to go back to Liyue?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Yes. Bring me 300 Qingxin, would you? Freshly picked, I mean.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uh, did Paimon hear that wrong?

choices.text: I think you might be a couple orders of magnitude off?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Hmm? Too much trouble, is it? Hmm... I see.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Then how about this: We have a few items that need delivering, perhaps you could help with that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds much more like it.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: 709 letters, to be precise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What gives? How come you don't have people to do that already!?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: Terribly sorry, we're just a little short on people lately...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What sort of an explanation is that!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Traveler, what're we gonna do? Should we really help this guy?

choices.text: I'll consider it.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
response.text: That's the spirit! Don't keep me waiting too long, now, hehe...

choices.text: I'll need to look into it more first.
They don't stay fresh after they're picked.
This is my forte.
Ultimately, they still got their way.
Hey there.

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: Halt, you two.

choices.text: Just as I expected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What did we do?

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: Miss Hiiragi has a letter for you. She insists that you read it immediately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A letter? Quick, let Paimon see!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dear Traveler, would that I could convey this message to you in person. I apologize for the hasty means by which this letter has come to you and I hope that it hasn't left you feeling perplexed or perturbed in any way. This is my first time extending an invitation to an unknown outlander, after all. It is no mere coincidence that our paths have crossed. Therefore, I hope that you would be so courteous as to meet me tonight, under the glow of resplendent moonlight. Please do not fret about retainers and bodyguards, I'll ensure that their attention will be elsewhere. I look forward to the pleasure of your company.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this means... she wants you to secretly meet her at night?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you didn't seem surprised at all by this... What's going on?

choices.text: We shared a glance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Have you been up to something behind Paimon's back?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... let's ask her tonight and see what she has to say.

choices.text: Shinsuke has no intention of letting us leave.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knew something just didn't seem right about him!

choices.text: Saw this coming.

talks.objective: Meet Ms. Hiiragi at the appointed time (18:00 – 24:00)

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Ah, you've finally arrived... Allow me to introduce myself, I am Hiiragi Chisato.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: This is... technically the second time we have met. It's a pleasure to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, she's the daughter of the Hiiragi Clan alright...

choices.text: The pleasure is mine.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: N—No need to be so formal — I've long marveled at your accomplishments... and at last we have the chance to meet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it Paimon, or does something seem a bit off here?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: The reason why I wanted to secretly meet you here is... Well, I feared that I might never have another opportunity to discuss this with you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: D—Discuss what?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Ahem... I should like to ask for your help with... delivering a letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, like father, like daughter! Couldn't you be more original?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: N—No! You misunderstand me — please... allow me to explain.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: I was hoping that you could deliver a letter to Narukami Island in my stead. It is to be given to Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: My father has always forbidden me from communicating with him. He knows that there are prospects for my marriage that would better serve him politically. But my heart is with Kamaji.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: There is no one who would dare defy my father's will on Ritou, but you are outlanders — outlanders seeking to get to Narukami Island. It would be regrettable to let such an opportunity pass...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon gets the whole picture now...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Of course, in doing so, I will also do everything in my power to help you leave Ritou. That is my promise.

choices.text: Hmm, seems like a reasonable deal.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: To be perfectly honest... as long as you remain in Inazuma, my father will have no intention of letting you leave Ritou.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we figured as much. It was pretty obvious he was just trying to hold us up here.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: I secretly overheard a conversation between my father and a very arrogant-sounding woman just a few days ago.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: They seemed to be discussing how to keep you here on Ritou. In fact, it was the first time I had ever heard my father speak so respectfully to someone who wasn't the shogun.

choices.text: An arrogant-sounding woman...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: We don't have much time. I'll tell you my plans to help you off the island. It just so happens that a shipment of goods is...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: (Hiiragi Chisato tells the Traveler her plans.)

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Very well, I'll be waiting for you at the border. I'm counting on you to deliver my letter.

choices.text: Seems we need to get off Ritou as fast as we can.
Seeing as we don't have any other options...
I'm leaving.
I'm delighted to see you again.

talks.objective: Go to Ritou's border to carry out Chisato's plan

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Hold on please... These goods are being sent to... Watatsumi Island?

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: My lady! This is an unexpected honor. You are correct, these goods have been repeatedly requested by the Kanjou Commissioner. We must be certain that they reach Watatsumi Island intact.

dialogues.speaker: Kenzaburou
dialogues.text: Is there something wrong, Lady Hiiragi?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: No, as you were. My father simply has some concerns of the shipment's safety, and has ordered that myself and an additional qualified escort be dispatched to ensure safe transport of the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Kenzaburou
dialogues.text: My lady, you aren't suggesting that you intend to escort the shipment personally, are you? There's certainly no need for you to trouble yourself with such a matter, and as for this "qualified escort"...

choices.text: I look forward to working with you.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Please, do not cause us any further delay. If memory serves me right, my father has already asserted that this shipment must arrive on time. I'm certain punishment will be duly dispensed if it fails to do so.

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Yes, of course my lady. I—It's just that... Well, we don't know who this—

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Now, need I remind you of the penalty if anything were to happen to me en route? I'm sure you are all quite familiar with my father's temperament.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Do you really presume that you can fully guarantee my safety on your own?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Boy, Chisato can talk the talk, they don't stand a chance...

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: A—Ah, yes my lady. Very well then... I—It's an honor to have you accompanying us. Your safety is our highest priority.

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Shinnojou! You can't really be agreeing to this!?

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: Well, the request is from Lady Hiiragi herself. It is our duty to serve her in the utmost capacity.

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Yes, but... that's not the problem here...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Well then, if we're through here, I suggest we set off at once. Dawdling will only allow potential thieves more time to prepare, no?

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Y—Yes, my lady. You heard her, there's no time to lose!

choices.text: You dare question my abilities?

talks.objective: Escort the goods and leave Ritou

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: Whew, we can take refuge in the village up ahead. How are you faring, my lady?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I'm perfectly alright. You may stop here. The road to Narukami Island is just over there.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: In my letter, I've requested Kamaji to grant you a special Travel Permit from the Tenryou Commission. Consider it a token of my appreciation.

choices.text: Thank you, Chisato.

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: My lady...?

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Huh! So that's how it is. I had a feeling something was amiss, but Shinnojou, you...

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: No, Lady Hiiragi would never hide anything from us, I'm sure of it. But who is this "Kamaji" you speak of, my lady?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: I'm not afraid to say that... he's the one I love.

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: The one... you love?

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Shinnojou... Did you honestly think that...?

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: What!? N—No, I uh... ahem! I was clarifying, that's all. I would never in my wildest dreams, uh... ahem!

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: You two needn't worry. Please, forget that this ever happened. If my father catches word of it, I alone will be held accountable.

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Yes, of course. As you wish, my lady.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what will happen if your actions here are discovered, Chisato?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Don't fret, my father has always been one to spoil me. The worst he'd do is sentence me to half a day without food, or something to that effect.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Paimon never suspected a guy like him could have a soft side...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: I wish you a safe journey. I'm sure we will meet again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye Chisato!

response.speaker: Kenzaburou
response.text: Come now! Quit your staring and let's get moving. We've got goods to shift.

response.speaker: Shinnojou
response.text: *whimpers* Al—Alright... *sobs*

choices.text: Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: Have you finished the work that we spoke about?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Shinsuke
dialogues.text: Report back to me once you've finished.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're seriously considering taking this job? The terms are ridiculous...

dialogues.speaker: Kenzaburou
dialogues.text: Monsters sighted! Prepare to counterattack!

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: Protect Lady Hiiragi at all costs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll take care of this. Stay with Chisato!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, we're finally on our own way again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I suppose it's time we find Thoma. Now where did he say he would meet us again... Right, Komore Teahouse!
